summary: Iran launched a ballistic missile from Isfahan Province at 17:16 local time. The IRGC claimed to have downed a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island, though the US has not confirmed. IDF Duvdevan commandos apprehended three Palestinians in the central West Bank who were planning terror attacks.
key_points: Ballistic missile launched from Isfahan, Iran at 17:16 local time. (Source: @shin_persian/12051)
IRGC claims downing US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island; no US confirmation. (Source: @N12chat/233713)
IDF Duvdevan Unit arrested three Palestinians in al-Am'ari Camp, a-Ram, and al-Bireh near Ramallah for planning terror attacks. (Source: @mannieFabian/59485)
President Trump to decide on resuming major strikes on Iran; CENTCOM finalizing preparations. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9682)
Four Iran-linked vessels loitering near subsea telecommunications cables in Gulf of Oman per Windward. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9688)
Greek shipping firm reports crew member killed in November 5 oil tanker explosion in Persian Gulf, possibly missile. (Source: @N12chat/233707)
Syrian forces arrested Hezbollah cell plotting attack on Homs oil refinery; Hezbollah denies presence. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9683)

Lebanese Army conducted explosions in Al-Haniyeh, Ma'roub, and Zoutar Al-Sharqiyah; hostile drone dropped sound bomb in Qabrikha. (Source: @redlinkleb/51958, @redlinkleb/51944, @redlinkleb/51922, @redlinkleb/51972)

sections.executive_summary: Iran launched a ballistic missile from Isfahan Province at 17:16 local time. The IRGC claimed to have downed a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island, though the US has not confirmed. IDF Duvdevan commandos apprehended three Palestinians in the central West Bank who were planning terror attacks.

points: A ballistic missile was launched from Isfahan Province at 17:16 local time (1346Z), detected by the FromIran monitoring network with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/12051)
A fighter aircraft took off from Dowran Air Base and conducted patrols over Shiraz, Fars Province at 10:50 local time (0720Z). (Source: @shin_persian/12045)
UAV activity was observed over Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12041)

UXO disposal operations occurred at Kuh-e Rah-e Haq in Isfahan with a small amount of smoke rising, and at Torqabeh near Mashhad in Razavi Khorasan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12046, @shin_persian/12044)
Russia advised its citizens to avoid travel to Iran following a meeting between Putin and Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council. (Source: @shin_persian/12040)
UKMTO Operations Centre issued Warning 197-26 for maritime security in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/12050)
Locals reported hearing explosions in Choman near the Iran border. (Source: @shin_persian/12049)

IDF Duvdevan commandos, directed by Shin Bet intelligence, raided al-Am'ari Camp, a-Ram, and al-Bireh near Ramallah and captured three Palestinians planning terror attacks and military activity against Israeli citizens and IDF troops. (Source: @mannieFabian/59485)
The Prime Minister's Office issued its first English-language statement on reported US security aid suspension, declaring "Israel has a strong economy." (Source: @yediotnews25/137395)
Donald Trump Jr. stated the Iran war significantly shifted voter attitudes and spiked fuel prices, influencing US midterm results. (Source: @yediotnews25/137386)
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth denied media reports they are leaving their positions. (Source: @yediotnews25/137385)

Three Palestinians planning terror attacks were apprehended by IDF Duvdevan Unit in the central West Bank villages of al-Am'ari Camp, a-Ram, and al-Bireh near Ramallah, following Shin Bet intelligence. (Source: @mannieFabian/59485)
The suspects were transferred to Shin Bet for further interrogation. (Source: @mannieFabian/59485)
The operation took place in the Benjamin Brigade area. (Source: @yediotnews25/137394)
No Gaza-specific military operations were reported in this dataset.
Lebanese Army conducted a controlled explosion in the town of Al-Haniyeh. (Source: @redlinkleb/51958)
Lebanese Army carried out an explosion in Ma'roub between 12:00 and 14:00. (Source: @redlinkleb/51944)
An explosion was reported in Zoutar Al-Sharqiyah. (Source: @redlinkleb/51922)
A hostile drone dropped a sound bomb toward a parked pickup truck near the stadium in Qabrikha, Marjayoun district, causing no injuries. (Source: @redlinkleb/51972)
Fire brushing activity was noted in the Aita Al-Jabal Al-Zat area. (Source: @redlinkleb/51949)

Syrian government counterterrorism forces arrested a Hezbollah cell accused of plotting to attack the Homs oil refinery; Hezbollah denies any presence in Syria and connection to the men, per SANA. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9683)

Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi spoke by phone with President Trump, affirming Iraq rejects its territory being used as a launchpad for attacks and remains committed to peaceful solutions for regional security. (Source: @shin_persian/12039)

At least four Iran-linked vessels have loitered near subsea telecommunications cables in the Gulf of Oman, raising concerns over possible cable surveillance or sabotage, per maritime intelligence firm Windward. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9688)

President Trump is expected to decide soon on resuming major strikes on Iran; CENTCOM is finalizing preparations for possible renewed combat operations but has not received new orders. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9682)
The IRGC claims to have shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island; no US confirmation has been issued. (Source: @N12chat/233713)

Greek shipping company Velos Shipping reported one crew member killed in a November 5 explosion on an oil tanker in the Persian Gulf, assessing the vessel was likely hit by a missile of unidentified origin. (Source: @N12chat/233707)

A December 11, 2026 federal funding deadline has some Democrats considering blocking money for the US-Iran conflict in budget negotiations, risking a government shutdown. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9695)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's ballistic missile launch from Isfahan and reported UAV activity over Urmia indicate heightened military readiness. The IRGC's claim of downing a US MQ-1 over Qeshm, if verified, would mark direct engagement with US assets. CENTCOM's strike preparations and Trump's impending decision suggest potential for rapid escalation. Meanwhile, Iran-linked vessel activity near Gulf of Oman cables introduces maritime sabotage risk. The West Bank arrests show ongoing Israeli counterterrorism pressure.
sections.regional_response: Russia advised citizens against travel to Iran following Putin's meeting with Iran's SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei, signaling diplomatic concern. Iraq's Prime Minister explicitly rejected use of Iraqi territory for attacks during call with Trump, attempting to distance Baghdad. Syrian authorities arrested a Hezbollah cell targeting Homs refinery, demonstrating Damascus's willingness to confront proxy activity. Lebanon's army conducted multiple controlled explosions and reported a hostile drone incident in the south.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 120-second delayed FromIran posts provide near-real-time tracking of Iranian air activity, including missile launches, jet patrols, and UAV flights. UKMTO Warning 197-26 indicates ongoing maritime security concerns in regional waters. Windward's detection of Iran-linked vessels near subsea cables warrants monitoring for potential hybrid threats. The November 5 tanker explosion in the Persian Gulf remains unattributed but aligns with patterns of maritime targeting. US domestic political dynamics, including potential funding blocks, may influence military decision timelines.
